items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: the great Matthews had somebody warmed up

ctx.x: Who was playing the World Series then? Do you remember?

Washington was one of the teams because the New Orleans boy Joe Martino pitched one in in while the great Matthews had somebody warmed up. Yeah that's why I was so interested in it because we had New Orleans pitchers to them. Sixty-five thousand people looking at the ball game. When that ball game was over I never saw so many people rush for the streetcars and what was a big shot and looked for a taxi cab. And I was just as hard to get into the streetcar. Taxi cab was about twenty cents a mile or something.…
I'm just wondering if you ever played many things for churches, you know, you mentioned being a mason. For the Shriners? Yeah. Well I played the Muslim ball every year.
